0022600104.text: The Charlotte Hornets (1-1, 3rd in the Southeast and 8th in the East) host the Miami Heat (0-2, 5th in the Southeast and 15th in the East), who have lost their last two games. Kylan Boswell is out after knee surgery, and Coby White, Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel are day-to-day with calf and hamstring injuries and are game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hornets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, though they won 136-106 in their last meeting in Charlotte.
